verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Sandbox environment with sandbox-specific testing for payments and disputes (square-docs-16, square-docs-21), allowing developers to test API calls without touching production/live data, and this is a well-established part of Square's developer platform per llms.txt overview (square-probe-1). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity, and explicit documentation of sandbox coverage across all APIs (e.g., subscriptions, payouts) rather than just payments/disputes.
